turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have about twenty minutes, so let's start with why my son's mark was changed to a zero and I found out from him, not from you.
"Get this over with." I'm writing that down. Withdraw the zero, then tell me who decided it and whether anyone spoke to Owen first.
Look, your son cheated. Everyone knows it. I'm not wasting my evening on this.
My son never lies. "Everyone knows" isn't evidence, Hale, so show me a document or I'm going upstairs to the principal.
You lawyers think you can bully anyone.
"Bully." I'm writing that down too. I asked a procedural question: did anyone speak to Owen before that zero went in, yes or no?
Are you going to keep wasting my time?

Your time. I came from my office with twenty minutes, and you've used four of them without answering one question. Yes or no, Hale: did you speak to Owen before you entered the zero, and did you call me?
